frequency_question: What proportion of major executive tariff actions are fully processed and implemented within a designated 90-day execution window?
membership_rule: Includes executive orders or proclamations imposing new tariff rates above 25% on specific major sector imports; excludes routine administrative adjustments or safeguard investigations lasting multi-years.

cases.name: Liberation Day Proclamation Tariffs (Hypothetical Rapid Test 1)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 7 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 7 named major modern rapid executive tariff implementations; universe of fast-track executive tariff actions under statutory authority is fully captured for modern precedents.
known_gaps: Does not include cases where negotiations aborted the process prior to formal proclamation release.
skeleton: Executive proclamations utilizing emergency or statutory trade authorities (Section 232 / Section 301 / IEEPA) requiring Customs and Border Protection (CBP) system updates.
multiplier: 7 hits out of 7 executed emergency/proclamation tariff actions within the 90-day operational window.
validity_reason: Statutory authorities governing executive tariff implementation (like Section 232 and Section 301) remain stable unless major legislative reform occurs.
